# Tjo

> A full-featured web framework for Go: routing, sessions, an ORM-less query
> builder, migrations, a database-backed job queue with durable steps, an
> authentication package, an admin panel, and server-sent events. Batteries
> included, standard library first.

Version: v0.11.0. Go 1.25 is the language floor, 1.26 the toolchain.

## What models get this wrong about

Read this section before writing any Tjo code. These are the mistakes that
appear in generated code because the training data predates them.

- **The import path is `github.com/jimmitjoo/tjo`**, with no version suffix.
  There is no `/v2`.
- **`go test ./...` does not test this repository.** It is a Go workspace
  (`go.work`). `email`, `otel`, `sms` and `websocket` are separate modules and
  a root-level `./...` silently skips all four. Use `make test`, or loop over
  the five module directories. The same applies to `go build`, `go vet`,
  `go mod tidy` and `govulncheck`.
- **Authentication logic does not belong in generated code.** Use the `auth`
  package: `auth.Authenticate`, `auth.ResetPassword`, `auth.VerifyTOTP`,
  `auth.Remember`, `auth.NewPasskeys`. As of v0.11.0 no template decides
  whether a credential is valid. Do not write bcrypt comparisons, token
  hashing or TOTP validation by hand.
- **Generated code is generated, not written.** `tjo make handler|controller|
  model|auth` and `tjo migrate` produce it. To change the output, change the
  template in `cmd/tjo/templates/`, not the file it produced.
- **A session must be renewed wherever authentication completes.** Password
  login, 2FA, passkey and remember-me. `session.RenewToken` followed by
  `tjo.RotateCSRFToken`. Skipping either is session fixation.
- **`jobs.SQLQueue` needs a worker that settles.** The framework's `Worker`
  does this; a hand-rolled loop that pops and runs will re-run every job
  forever, because claiming a row is not completing it.
- **The admin panel refuses to serve without an authorizer.** That is not a
  bug to work around; `admin.AllowAll` exists for development and says so.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/jimmitjoo/tjo/blob/main/readme.md): install, quick start, the whole feature list
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jimmitjoo/tjo/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how to work in this repository, and the traps that have shipped defects
- [Configuration](https://github.com/jimmitjoo/tjo/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): environment variables and the config struct
- [Query builder](https://github.com/jimmitjoo/tjo/blob/main/docs/query-builder.md): the fluent API over database/sql
- [Modules](https://github.com/jimmitjoo/tjo/blob/main/docs/modules.md): the separate email, otel, sms and websocket modules
- [Extending](https://github.com/jimmitjoo/tjo/blob/main/docs/extending.md): writing your own modules
- [OpenTelemetry](https://github.com/jimmitjoo/tjo/blob/main/docs/opentelemetry.md): tracing, metrics and the ops dashboard
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/jimmitjoo/tjo/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release, and why
- [SECURITY](https://github.com/jimmitjoo/tjo/blob/main/SECURITY.md): the advisory policy, including that generated code is in scope

## Packages

- `auth`: passwords, login, single-use tokens, TOTP, recovery codes, passkeys, organizations, roles
- `admin`: model-driven CRUD panel, reflection over your structs
- `ops`: self-hosted dashboard for errors, slow requests, queues, cron and health
- `jobs`: database-backed queue, workers, and durable checkpointed workflows
- `database`: query builder, migrations, seeding, health checks
- `sse`: server-sent events and topic broadcast
- `security`: throttling, headers, validation, CSRF configuration
- `cache`, `session`: Redis and Badger backends
- `core`: helpers usable without the framework

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/jimmitjoo/tjo/blob/main/llms-full.txt): the same, with API signatures and worked examples
